standfirst: A pianist turned divorce lawyer, three friends who behave like adults, and case work that treats separation as a logistics problem with feelings attached. The one law drama of 2023 worth the time. These six are for procedure plus friendship, without the courtroom theatrics.

picks.why: Divorce law as the actual subject. Same case structure, same interest in custody, assets and the moment a client stops pretending. Both are about the profession rather than one big trial. Difference: it is a mentor and junior story and it is much angrier about the men in it.

A lawyer whose difference is the method. Same weekly case rhythm, same warmth toward colleagues, same refusal to make the law heroic. Difference: it is far sunnier, and its emotional centre is a workplace learning to accommodate somebody.

Lawyers as people with commutes. Same low-key register where the job is a job and the friendships carry the show. Difference: almost no case drives the plot, so it is closer to a slice-of-life ensemble than a procedural.

The unglamorous mechanics of a firm. Same pleasure in watching competent people handle other people's worst weeks. Difference: the focus is a trainee learning the trade, so the perspective is junior and the stakes are careers.

Middle-aged decency as a plot. Same interest in men who are tired, kind and specific, and in friendship as the thing that holds a life together. Difference: no case work at all, and the emotional weight is much heavier.

Legal work with a comic engine attached. Same appetite for a lawyer with an unorthodox method and a small loyal team. Difference: the premise is supernatural and the tone is broad, so nothing lands with real weight.

against.title: Law School
against.why: The obvious legal recommendation, and a very different show: a closed campus mystery driven by a single death, with lectures instead of clients.

against.title: The Devil Judge
against.why: Named for the law label. It is a dystopian spectacle about televised sentencing; Divorce Attorney Shin is about a woman deciding who keeps the apartment.

against.title: Vincenzo
against.why: Paired because the lead is also a lawyer with an unusual background. That is a mob comedy with explosions. This one has three friends and a mediation room.
